experiments.study_type: focal delayed-type hypersensitivity model of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (fDTH-EAE)
experiments.procedure_text: fDTH-EAE model in rats evaluated by PET/CT imaging, ex vivo tissue analysis, histology, and immunofluorescence after treatment with EC2319.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: A focal delayed-type hypersensitivity model of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (fDTH-EAE) was established as previously described
experiments.test_system_evidence: In vivo imaging was performed with an Inveon multimodality small animal PET/CT device... the animals were sacrificed and various tissues were excised
experiments.route_evidence: The rats in the acute phase (day 14) groups were subcutaneously administered with EC2319... 68 Ga-FOL... was injected IV

endpoints.label: neuroinflammation
endpoints.evidence: immune cell-mediated inflammatory response in bacillus Calmette-Guérin-induced intrastriatal lesions

endpoints.label: PET/CT imaging
endpoints.evidence: 68 Ga-FOL PET/CT at 60 days after lesion activation

endpoints.label: ex vivo gamma counting
endpoints.evidence: sacrifice for ex vivo gamma counting of excised tissues

endpoints.label: histology and immunofluorescence
endpoints.evidence: The brain cryosections were analyzed by autoradiography, histology, and immunofluorescence

endpoints.label: cytokine and chemokine levels
endpoints.evidence: Plasma levels of interferon γ (IFN-γ) and interleukins IL-1β, IL-4, IL-6, and IL-10 were measured

substances.name: 68 Ga-FOL
substances.evidence: 68 Ga-FOL (45 ± 1 MBq, range 47-41 MBq) was injected IV

exposure.frequency: 0, 3, 7, and 10 days after lesion activation; biweekly for 4 weeks

experiments.notes: EC2319 dosages differ between acute (750 nmol/kg/day) and chronic (500 nmol/kg/day) experimental cohorts.
